name: plugin-google

metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which only cover this project's own files. `src/boundaries.test.ts` runs Nx's module-boundaries rule through Oxlint with the options of `.oxlintrc.json` on samples in every plugin package, so a change to `.oxlintrc.json`, to a plugin's project.json (its tags), to Oxlint, @nx/oxlint, Nx or TypeScript must re-run it. Setting `inputs` REPLACES the inferred array, so the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared.
